Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 8.2; court I. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M34JJ77XECH5T7J2K1ZKGFV8; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own shared edition saved-state representation and app Save/Reopen adapter. Bind exact artifacts/schema/result/cut, qualified focus/selection, context, viewport anchors and independent horizons/cursors. Browser handles/blob URLs/display strings are not identities; state grants no content permission.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Exact artifacts restore semantic state including no-selection and unavailable/off-projection placement while pixels may reflow.
2. Changed/missing source/recall/result bytes and revoked capabilities refuse or explicitly restrict restoration; never guess by title, ordinal or offset.
3. No private text/media/paths are embedded by default; version/roundtrip and real browser save/reopen witnesses pass.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Unknown schemas refuse; preserve original artifacts and supported standalone exports.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Save and restore versioned identity-bound investigations
